name: AH-64E Apache
note: Boeing AH-64E Apache Guardian attack helicopter, crew of 2 (pilot + co-pilot/gunner). Performance figures are the published AH-64A/D numbers (the AH-64E is broadly similar, slightly faster). Primary armament: AGM-114 Hellfire ATGM and 30 mm M230 chain gun; AH-64E adds the JAGM. AN/APG-78 Longbow millimetre-wave fire-control radar.

name: Ka-52 Alligator
note: Kamov Ka-52 Alligator, coaxial-rotor two-seat (side-by-side) scout/attack helicopter. Primary armament 9K121 Vikhr ATGM and 2A42 30 mm cannon; also carries the newer LMUR (izdeliye 305) ~14.5 km ATGM and Igla air-to-air missiles. Radar/EO detection ~25 km ground / 15 km air.
